$comment: THE EXPLICIT DEBT LIST, read by tests/guard-hygiene.mjs.
A guard file that nothing runs is not coverage — it is a file that LOOKS like
coverage. tests/worker-accrual.mjs sat here for months with a header claiming
run-smoke.mjs invoked it; nothing did, and thirteen assertions about an economy
faucet went uncollected. This file exists so that state can never be silent
again: every tests/*.mjs is registered in .github/workflows/smoke.yml, invoked
by tests/run-smoke.mjs, chained from another guard, or NAMED HERE WITH A REASON.
Being on this list is not an endorsement. It is a debt with an owner. Adding an
entry is cheap and deliberate; the cost is that it is written down and countable.
`verified` says what was actually measured on 2026-09-06 by the slice-2 audit —
not what the file's own header claims. `asserts` = the file can exit non-zero.
A file with asserts:false cannot be red and therefore gates nothing, whatever

no-new-prediction.mjs.reason: Registered in tools/lane-done.mjs (the per-lane runner) rather than in smoke.yml: this lane was briefed to add the guard WITHOUT editing the workflow, because .github/workflows/smoke.yml is the Coordinator's file and tests/ci-shape.baseline.json pins its step list. Both arms pass on today's tree (plain run green at 35 call sites, --selftest green on 8 controls including a clean arm). Its CI home is the `guards` job beside tests/no-client-xp-mint.mjs, as TWO steps — the plain run, then --selftest — and this entry is the written debt until the Coordinator adds them.

settle-carry-defer.mjs.reason: Registered in tools/lane-done.mjs (BOTH arms — the plain run and --mutate, per RULE 5) rather than in smoke.yml, for the reason no-new-prediction.mjs gives above: .github/workflows/smoke.yml is the Coordinator's file and tests/ci-shape.baseline.json pins its step list, and this lane was briefed not to move either. This is the succession the settle-carry-loss.mjs entry below predicted in writing: the carry IS threaded for real as of 2026-09-16 (accrual.js `settledWatermarkMs` advances `accrued_to` to the time the simulation accounted for), so the forfeited-time property is now an invariant with a gate instead of a number with a footnote. It chains real computeAccrual calls through the real delta.accrued_to across all THREE payable channels plus the four by-design refusals (capped / finalWindow / stopped-early / the C6 attended floor) and the two facts the fix must not have moved (the idempotency key and the PRNG label still read the window START). Runs in ~2 s, no database, no network. ITS CI HOME is the `guards` job beside tests/no-client-xp-mint.mjs, as two steps; this entry is the written debt until the Coordinator adds them.

settle-carry-loss.mjs.reason: MEASUREMENT, not a gate. It prices what the call-local `carryMs` in simulateSpan/sliceSpan costs at the REAL 90 s settle cadence (SETTLE_INTERVAL_MS) and exits 0 by design — it states a number, it does not defend a contract, and registering a number-printer in CI would make the guards job red the day a balance change moved a weapon speed. `--mutate` DOES assert (it exits 1 if threading the carry fails to take the forfeited time to ~0), which is what makes the number checkable; run it by hand when the engine's tick budget changes. SUCCEEDED 2026-09-16: the carry was threaded for real, so the forfeited-time property became a real invariant and moved to the sibling settle-carry-defer.mjs (entry above), which is registered and whose --mutate arm reprints these numbers as its red proof. This file's own metric now subtracts `res.deferredMs`, so its tables read ~0 on a working tree — deferred time is not forfeited time, and a metric that kept counting it would report a loss the player no longer takes. It remains the DIAGNOSIS, priced against the engines, and it remains report-only.

signup-door-page.mjs.reason: DELIBERATELY not in CI, by its own header and for a good reason: DOOR-1..7 and OPEN-3 already live in src/features/smoke-test.js and run inside the assembled in-page suite, which IS the contract. This file re-runs the SAME in-page runner filtered to one battery (window.__smokeTest({only})) so an agent proving one battery does not have to start a second multi-minute suite next to somebody else's and read the contention as a flake (b461). Registering it would duplicate the assertions and reintroduce exactly that contention. It is a development tool, not a gate.

character-bootstrap-guard.mjs.reason: family pglite-chain-replay: hr_create_character is an ENSURE and grants exactly src/data/start-kit.js. NOTE: measured as asserts:false — it reports rather than exits non-zero, so registering it as-is would gate nothing. Needs a verdict before adoption.

enchant-intent.mjs.reason: family pglite-chain-replay: the enchant intent against real PostgreSQL.

gold-intents.mjs.reason: family pglite-chain-replay: shop_buy and vendor_sell at the catalogue price/bid. Overlaps the registered conservation-fuzz step, which fuzzes the same value-movement invariants.

leaderboard-lockdown-guard.mjs.reason: family pglite-chain-replay: the boards are not writable by a client. The live source property IS registered inside run-smoke (leaderboard-server-source).

market-offers-guard.mjs.reason: family pglite-chain-replay: market offer integrity. run-smoke already registers market-v2 and market-intent, which drive the market's value movement.

market-offers-lockdown.mjs.reason: family pglite-chain-replay. NOTE: measured as asserts:false — it prints a lockdown report and cannot exit non-zero, so it gates nothing today. Either give it a verdict or fold it into market-offers-guard.

gem-daily-budget.mjs.reason: family pglite-chain-replay: Security's blocking condition 1 — no delta key without a per-call clamp AND a per-day ledger-derived ceiling. NOTE: measured as asserts:false, so the condition is currently DOCUMENTED rather than enforced by this file. The clamp itself is enforced server-side by hr_day_budget_limits(). Worth a verdict.

open-beta.mjs.reason: family pglite-chain-replay: the open-beta invite/door surface. The in-page suite registers beta-invite-gate for the live half.

world-tick-parity.mjs.reason: Step 1 of the live-world program (docs/planning/WORLD_TICK_DESIGN.md) is a READ-ONLY SHADOW spike, and its brief says register nothing in CI yet — the service it guards writes nothing and ships to nothing, so a CI step would gate the build on a component that cannot affect a player. It asserts (exit 1 on any problem) and carries three --mutate proofs (unaligned / nofight / capIsCadence), all verified red on 2026-09-16. It runs in ~1 s, needs no database and no network. WHAT REGISTERING IT COSTS: a step in .github/workflows/smoke.yml (plain arm AND --mutate arm, per RULE 5) plus a re-pin of tests/ci-shape.baseline.json — see WORLD_TICK_DESIGN.md §13, which lists the full CI shape this program needs. It is registered the moment the tick becomes a writer for any channel, and NOT LATER: P4 is a tripwire that must be flipped to an equality when the rngState seam lands, and a tripwire nothing runs is not a tripwire.

$deleted:2026-09-06-slice-2.reason: NOT A GUARD FILE — the record of two orphans DELETED rather than adopted, so the decision is not re-litigated by whoever next greps for them. (1) tests/gold-intent-shape.mjs: a one-off investigation script, not a guard — it took the repo root as process.argv[2] and could not be run without one, printed a shape report, and asserted nothing that the registered conservation-fuzz and claim-intent steps do not already assert by execution against the same hr_apply. (2) tests/raid-claim-exploit.mjs: the b209 own-contribution-claim exploit reproduction, written against a HAND-BUILT partial schema in PGlite rather than the real migration chain, so it could pass while production diverged. The property it cared about — a free-rider cannot claim — is covered by the registered raid-band-denial step, whose --selftest plants exactly that defect against the real chain. Both bodies remain in git history at afa7175e~1.

$note:client-write-sweep-2345.reason: NOT A GUARD FILE — why the four client-write-sweep guards were NOT collapsed into one, per the slice-2 brief's "only if provably one seam" condition. They are not one seam. Each pins a DIFFERENT migration with a different confirmed-writer population and a different property: -2 = display_names/leaderboard_meta + 2 writers; -3 = raid_claims/raid_contributions + 2 writers, plus the batch-1 MAINTAIN retrofit; -4 = 17 tables, 34 baseline rows, 42 writers driven before AND after the revoke, plus the two tables deliberately left granted; -5 is not a table batch at all — it is the fail-closed DEFAULT ACL, the schema-wide MAINTAIN revoke and the hr_assert_grant_hygiene detector takeover. Merging them would fuse four independent revert-detectors into one pass/fail, so a red would no longer name which batch regressed, and -5's default-ACL property has no table list to merge into. All four are invoked by tests/run-smoke.mjs and are therefore not orphans.

$family:pglite-chain-replay.reason: NOT A GUARD FILE — a note covering the entries tagged family 'pglite-chain-replay'. Each boots a real PostgreSQL (PGlite/WASM) and applies the WHOLE migration chain verbatim before asserting, which costs minutes per file. CI already replays that chain once, in the registered `schema-drift` step (plus its --mutate and --live-selftest). Registering these individually would multiply the chain replay by the file count and turn a 20-minute workflow into an hour, for guards whose migrations also carry their own executing self-check blocks. The right fix is a SHARED replayed database these all attach to (tests/schema-replay.mjs already exports bootReplay for exactly this) — a real piece of work, not a line in a YAML file.

$proof_baseline_comment: RULE 5 (guard-hygiene): a step registered with --selftest/--mutate must have the
guard's PLAIN run registered too — in smoke.yml beside it, or plainly by
run-smoke.mjs. A proof arm answers 'can this guard go red'; only the plain arm
answers 'is it green when nothing is wrong'. On 2026-09-12 a planted bad column
in a guard's own SQL made every arm throw and the driver printed 'All 6
mutations caught', exit 0, with no plain run anywhere in CI to contradict it.
An entry below is an EXEMPTION from that rule and must say why the plain run
cannot gate. 22 of the 23 exposed steps were paid off (registered) instead;

visual-qa.mjs.reason: Its plain run is not a gate and cannot be one: `node tests/visual-qa.mjs` launches Playwright, drives every screen and WRITES the screenshot set to docs/reports/visual-qa/ for a human (Art Director) to read — it reports rather than exiting non-zero on a look. The gating half is tests/visual-qa-gate.mjs, whose plain run IS registered in the same step. The --selftest arm here is the one thing in this file that can be red, which is why it is what CI runs.
